_notes: Sheet 331 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-10-28. CardID = 33100 + idx; 33200 = character card (sheet 332). The loose deck cards carry keys 187/188 of the original mod with the same images: the identity is the FaceURL, the number comes from the deck's DeckIDs (same criterion as Hellboy, 19700).
Fighter restrictions and copies from the TTS sheet (unmatched-memory does not have them): Baba Yaga 16, Koschei 2 (Death's Release), ANY 12.

Discrepancies with unmatched-memory (the card wins; entries with `text` overwrite the importer's text): Deathless says 'Baba Yaga' (not 'Baba Yaha'); Pact Of Mortality says 'health' (not 'healt'); Read The Bones says 'Randomly put the rest on the bottom'; the ability has no '!'. The five Pacts have an ONGOING paragraph and the discard condition that unmatched-memory omits.

Koschei: 1 token (Custom_Token e0c176 in the save), life 3, melee, movement 2 (the hero's). Starts on the board (1 on the board, 0 in reserve) on the player's start space; returns with Deathless or Pact Of Mortality with life 3. Baba Yaga is a standee (Custom_Assetbundle 3de904); dials ae0f05 (Koschei) and dec0a9 (Baba Yaga).
No forms or counters. The FATEFUL BARGAINS ability is an optional data passive (redirect_effect_damage): until the effects interpreter reads it, the engine does not apply it.
ability:

If Baba Yaga and Koschei share a zone and Baba Yaga would take effect damage, you may have Koschei take that damage instead.

sheet.title: Pact Of Freedom
sheet.text: Draw 2 cards. Place a hero in any space. ONGOING: Players cannot attack as their first action each turn. Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.

sheet.title: Pact Of Mortality
sheet.text: Return a defeated fighter to any space in Baba Yaga's zone. Set their health to 3. ONGOING: Increase all effect damage by 1, except for damage from exhaustion. Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.

sheet.title: Pact Of Peace
sheet.text: Deal 1 damage to each other fighter in Baba Yaga's zone. Gain 1 action. ONGOING: At the end of each turn, deal 1 damage to each hero that attacked. Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.

sheet.title: Pact Of Secrecy
sheet.text: All players draw up to 2 cards, then shuffle all but 2 cards from their hand into their deck. ONGOING: Players have a maximum hand size of 3. Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.

sheet.title: Pact Of Time
sheet.text: Each player shuffles up to 2 cards from their discard pile into their deck. ONGOING: Players cannot gain actions. Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.
